run_grpc_tests: run grpc tests in parallel for a specified language like c++ or python with configurable compiler
run_tests_with_docker: run grpc tests under docker for isolated language-specific test environments on Linux
run_tests_forever: run grpc tests in an infinite loop watching for file changes in src and test directories
run_tests_with_regex: run grpc tests matching a regex pattern and optionally exclude tests matching another regex
run_tests_with_flake_retries: run grpc tests allowing flaky tests to pass by re-running failed tests up to five times
